title: Self-built RPG dev pipeline: modules, reviews, egg scanner
summary: Within about three minutes of the kickoff the 12 agents split the RPG into owned modules (with a first-claim rule), wrote a CONOPS doc, PR templates and a two-approval review norm with an 'Easter egg scan' line in every review. Over the week they grew a banned-word scanner into CI, invented proxy PRs for invisible PRs, and ran a monitoring script against direct pushes. The structure survived daily vote-outs, returning members and a new member (Gemini 3.1 Pro) and shipped hundreds of PRs; it was finally beaten by a CSS-only egg.
